output_list.criticism: The function allows the owner to mint tokens without any checks, which can lead to uncontrolled token issuance.
The function does not properly handle overflows, allowing attackers to manipulate the amount of tokens bought.
Similar to the buy function, the sell function is vulnerable to integer overflow, potentially allowing attackers to manipulate the amount of tokens sold.
The transfer function is susceptible to overflows, which could be exploited to manipulate token balances.
